purpose: Compare the local ASD-shape derivatives of residual c2, C_tes, and L at each day's Magnicon+c2 best fit to expose readout/detector identifiability geometry.
guardrail: Derivative alignment is an identifiability statement, not causal attribution. C_tes or L can align with the c2 shape because different model freedoms generate similar normalized ASD changes. The derivatives are local to each fitted operating point; the finite c2-removal comparison is included to expose nonlinearity. Magnicon pole/Q and white are frozen throughout the derivative calculation.
